text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahahaha! Time for the results 
announcement~!!
choice_data_list: What is it all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What is it? It's the announcement of the 
fan vote results for the Arima Kinen. 
They're about to show it on TV.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
My goal this time is— to make it through 
with a massive landslide of votes!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I can no longer afford to trail behind the 
previous generation, even when it comes to 
popularity.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sure everything will be fine, Opera 
O-san...

With Meisho Doto watching as well, the 
show begins. Now, as for the result—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
"Next up, T.M. Opera O's vote count 
is...!"
(Pa-pa-pa-pa-pa-paaah!!)

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: "T.M. Opera O!"

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
"93,217 votes! With a commanding share of 
the vote, her entry into the Arima Kinen 
is officially confirmed!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: O... O... Oooooh!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: I did it, I did it! Bwahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I want to share this joy with all my 
loving subjects!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san, hah-hah-hah!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
What...!? Could you not just barge into my 
room?

After running all over the place in an 
explosion of joy.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, please hold a press 
conference.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it obvious? It's a declaration of my 
resolve as we head toward the Arima Kinen!
And so, the stage was set, but—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun... I would hope not, but you 
aren't going to pull the rug out from 
under me, are you?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. I just suddenly remembered, you 
see. That press conference right after 
your debut race."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Even back then, I believed in my own 
popularity, but only a single reporter 
showed up...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Back then... It was nice and quiet, 
wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"No, Doto. That's not what I meant at 
all!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Sometimes I wonder... if all the glory up 
to this point was merely a summer night's 
dream seen by the King."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I feared that the moment I opened that 
door, the dream would shatterâ and all 
that awaited me would be a desolate 
wasteland.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ghk... This isn't like me... To be cowed 
by idle dreams and halt my stride...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
No, I'll open it myself. I want to show 
you my dashing, dignified self at all 
times, after all.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Shake off the nightmare! How could all the 
pleasure, all the praise up until now have 
just been a dream?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Forward, gate—open!
(Screeeeech!)

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hyauuuuu!?

My fears were groundless. The press 
conference hall was packed with people, 
people, people...

Everyone gathered, seeking the words of 
T.M. Opera O, completely filling the 
venue.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
F-Fufufu... Fufufufu... It's wonderful, 
isn't it...

T.M. Opera O, who is usually the first to 
laugh aloud, unusually didn't laugh.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Looking back, only one reporter came for 
the first interview. And nobody showed up 
for the dinner show afterward, either...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Just take a look around! Right now, so 
many people are calling out for me—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san, congratulations on entering 
the Grand Prix!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"Looking sharp today as well! Could we get 
a comment?!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
This is it... This is what I've been 
searching for all along...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... against my better judgment... my 
eyes... Even the "Supreme Overlord" sheds 
a tear...

She was deeply moved. She must have been 
truly happy.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san, would you like more eye 
drops...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "Of course I do! Give me a dozen, Doto."
...It was just staged.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, my lords who have gathered, well 
done. And thank you.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Tonight, let us speak at length of our 
feelings after receiving such overwhelming 
support from the fans.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A four-act epic lasting a full eight 
hours! "The Tale of T.M. Opera O: Nakayama 
of Wrath"!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Urrrgh...

Even the reporters were visibly taken 
aback, but the press conference still 
ended in roaring success.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer-kun. Quite a lot of 
time has passed since my debut race, 
but...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It's only because of your support that I 
was able to make it this far.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
To you, who are like that... I'd like to 
give a modest present.
choice_data_list: What are you gonna give me?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, I don't have it just yet. 
I'll be giving it to you half a month from 
now—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The gift I want to give you is "the 
ultimate joy." Victory in the Arima Kinen, 
and the title of Best Trainer.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I will personally serve as the presenter. 
So, will you wait for me? —At that place.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed—the throne. The throne of the 
"Overlord of the Century's End."
(WOOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The Winner's Circle at the Arima Kinen. 
That's the very place where my coronation 
will take place!
